records.text: An anonymous UVU student told CNN that he saw a man on or near the Losee Center roof twice in the two weeks before the shooting, last saw him at noon one week before the shooting, and reported the observations to the FBI tip line afterward.
records.speaker: Anonymous UVU student (CNN report, Ep 581dILVcEE4)

appearances.snippet: Utah Valley University student recalls seeing man walking on or near the Losee Center roof twice in two weeks. ... the student says that he last saw the person on the roof last Wednesday at noon, a week before the shooting. ... He told CNN that he reported his observations to the FBI tip line after the shooting, but he has not heard back.

verification.notes: Verified as an attribution claim. CNN reported that an unnamed UVU student said he saw a man on or near the Losee Center roof twice, last saw him at noon one week before the shooting, and later contacted the FBI tip line. Owens read the same account in the episode. The student’s identity and whether the observed person was connected to the shooting remain unestablished.
